purpose: Make Technical Twin and Creative Twin evidence explicit so N0TE can distinguish technical state from creative intent, preserve both when they disagree, and never infer taste from measurement/source labels.

lineage.outcome: The artist can see what N0TE technically observes versus what the artist creatively intends, and disagreement is surfaced without silently choosing or fixing the art.
lineage.capability: Explicit Technical Twin / Creative Twin evidence lenses

legacy_candidates: Technical Twin / Creative Twin semantics as behavioral evidence only
legacy_rejections: technical evidence automatically overriding creative intent

completion_proof: evidence schema v1 migrates transactionally to v2 and every existing claim preserves id/value/source/ref/confidence/supersession while becoming UNSPECIFIED rather than guessed
new claims explicitly accept only TECHNICAL, CREATIVE or UNSPECIFIED Twin domain independent of source kind
version-specific TECHNICAL evidence and broader Song CREATIVE intent for the same key can coexist and surface a conflict with no selected winner
scope specificity is resolved independently per Twin so one lens cannot erase the other
same-valued technical and creative evidence does not manufacture a conflict
Song A Twin evidence never resolves for Song B
restart preserves Twin domain and the normal Headquarters Song Knowledge Map exposes twin_domain on evidence nodes
invalid or tampered Twin domains fail visibly
after schema initialization repeated Twin reads insert/update/delete zero canonical rows
non_scope: Audio Intelligence or automatic technical diagnosis
next_selection_rule: After CORE-01H evidence, reconcile and globally reselect. Do not expand Twins, audio diagnosis or Artist World by adjacency.
